install.name: Node.js 22 runtime
install.run: set -eu; arch=$(uname -m); case "$arch" in x86_64) arch=x64 ;; aarch64|arm64) arch=arm64 ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac; mkdir -p .revolte/runtime/node; curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.23.2/node-v22.23.2-linux-$arch.tar.xz" | tar -xJ --strip-components=1 -C .revolte/runtime/node

install.name: Application dependencies
install.check: export PATH="$PWD/.revolte/runtime/node/bin:$PATH"; test -d node_modules && test -f .revolte/runtime/package-lock.installed && cmp -s package-lock.json .revolte/runtime/package-lock.installed && npm ls --depth=0
install.run: export PATH="$PWD/.revolte/runtime/node/bin:$PATH"; npm ci && mkdir -p .revolte/runtime && cp package-lock.json .revolte/runtime/package-lock.installed
